messages:
Maya (CS): Heads up — Veridian Labs renewal is stuck. They signed the SOW but treasury refuses wiring because invoice entity doesn't match their vendor record. They want an invoice to 'Veridian Labs, Inc.' and a PO number. E-sign link was sent but accounting won't release until names line up. Can we triage?
Olivia (Finance): Got it. Their vendor record in NetSuite is 'Veridian Labs, LLC' — mismatch with SOW. We can either issue a corrected invoice or accept a PO that references our contract number and includes remittance details. Do they have a vendor ID or PO coming?
Maya (CS): They said they'll try to get a PO by EOD. Also legal asked about signer authority on the SOW — e-sign shows 'V. Park (VP Finance)'. Carlos, is that sufficient?
Carlos (Legal): VP Finance is fine for signature authority. The blocker is the legal entity on the invoice. We can issue a corrected invoice to 'Veridian Labs, Inc.' if they send a signed amendment changing billing entity, OR we can accept a scanned PO that references the contract number and includes an authorized signature. Recommend quick call to confirm.
Liam (Sales): I'll spin up a 30m call at 3pm PT. If they can get procurement on that call we can get PO or amendment live. Also, could we temporarily accept the PO and create a change order after? Ops/Finance opinions?
Olivia (Finance): If the PO explicitly references the contract number and includes billing/remittance details, Finance will accept it for payment processing. We still need the amendment for audit trails, so please flag it as 'provisional' and follow up with signed docs.
Maya (CS): Sharing details — e-sign link: https://redwood.example/esign/abcd1234. Invoice ID: Q-2026-4827. Excerpt of SOW for ref: ```SOW Veridian Q1 2026 - 10 seats - $120k```
Esign Bot: Document abcd1234 viewed at 1876543300 by V. Park (veridian.park@veridian.com)
Liam (Sales): Perfect — I'll push for PO this afternoon on the call. @Olivia please hold off issuing a final invoice until we have either PO or amendment. If they push back, I'll escalate to their procurement lead.
Olivia (Finance): Acknowledged. I'll prepare a provisional invoice addressed to 'Veridian Labs, LLC' and mark it 'provisional — pending amendment' so payment team can track but not remit until audit docs are complete.
Maya (CS): :thumbsup: Thanks. Carlos, can you drop the amendment template into this thread so we can send to them right after the call?
Carlos (Legal): Will do. Quick note: we can accept a signed PO that references the contract and includes an authorized signature as an interim measure. Otherwise we need the amendment. I'll post the template now.
Maya (CS): Update from call — PO received (they uploaded to portal). PO# V-2026-998, received at 1876543700. Procurement confirmed it references our contract number and includes authorized signature. Finance, can you proceed?
Olivia (Finance): Confirmed. Payment path validated; we'll queue the invoice for processing once the amendment is received, and mark the PO as valid for now. :white_check_mark: 
Maya (CS): Closing loop — onboarding kickoff scheduled for next week. I'll follow up if amendment comes through or if procurement needs the signed change order. Thanks team.
